helpers.name: contextField

helpers.name: decode
helpers.summary: Decode a raw Streams event into the SAME flat, `event_type`-discriminated row shape Index serves — so Streams consumption reads identically to Index consumption, with one call instead of eleven guard+decode pairs.

helpers.name: decodeClarityValue

helpers.name: fetchRewardSet

errors.name: ApiError
errors.summary: Error thrown by `SecondLayer` when an API request fails.

errors.name: ArchiveAuthError
errors.summary: Thrown on a 401 from the archive ops host (quote/fetch/credits).

errors.name: ArchiveGateNotConfiguredError
errors.summary: Thrown on a 503 when the archive fetch gate is unconfigured.

errors.name: ArchiveSignatureError
errors.summary: Thrown when an archive manifest signature is missing or does not verify.

errors.name: AuthError
errors.summary: Thrown on a 401 by both the instance clients and Streams.

errors.name: InsufficientArchiveCreditsError
errors.summary: Thrown on a 402 from archive fetch — prepaid credits do not cover the quote.

errors.name: RateLimitError
errors.summary: Thrown on a 429 by both the instance clients and Streams.

errors.name: StreamsServerError
errors.summary: Thrown on a 5xx from the Streams API, and on a failed signing-key fetch.

errors.name: StreamsSignatureError
errors.summary: Thrown when response signature verification is enabled and fails.

errors.name: ValidationError
errors.summary: Thrown on a 4xx the caller can fix (bad cursor, bad params).
